# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- Generated by `vellora --export-shortcuts` from the command registry. Do not edit by hand: CI regenerates this page and fails if it differs. -->

Every action of Vellora is a command with a name, listed here with its shortcut. Any command, with or without a shortcut, can be run from the command palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P`): type part of its name and press Enter.

On macOS, Ctrl means the Command key. Shortcuts for standard actions (Open, Print, Close Tab, Quit, Copy, Select All, Find, Zoom In, Zoom Out) are the ones your system defines for them, so they can differ from the keys shown here: this page shows the keys on a plain Linux system, where Quit has no shortcut of its own (Quit is also in the File menu).

## File

| Command | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Open… | `Ctrl+O` |
| Print… | `Ctrl+P` |
| Close Tab | `Ctrl+F4` |
| Reopen Closed Tab | `Ctrl+Shift+T` |

## Tabs

| Command | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Next Tab | `Ctrl+Tab` |
| Previous Tab | `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` |

## Edit

| Command | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Copy | `Ctrl+C` |
| Select All | `Ctrl+A` |
| Select All on Page | `Ctrl+Shift+A` |
| Find… | `Ctrl+F` |
| Find Next | `F3` |
| Find Previous | `Shift+F3` |

## View

| Command | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Caret Browsing | `F7` |
| Next Link | `F8` |
| Previous Link | `Shift+F8` |
| Search Results | `Ctrl+Shift+F` |
| Page Thumbnails | `F4` |
| Outline | `Ctrl+Shift+O` |
| Document Info | `Ctrl+I` |
| Go to Page… | `Ctrl+G` |
| Previous View | `Alt+Left` |
| Next View | `Alt+Right` |
| Zoom In | `Ctrl++`, `Ctrl+=` |
| Zoom Out | `Ctrl+-` |
| Actual Size | `Ctrl+1` |
| Fit Width | `Ctrl+2` |
| Fit Page | `Ctrl+0` |
| Rotate Clockwise | `Ctrl+]` |
| Rotate Counterclockwise | `Ctrl+[` |
| Next Page | `Ctrl+Down` |
| Previous Page | `Ctrl+Up` |

## Command palette

| Command | Shortcut |
|---|---|
| Command Palette… | `Ctrl+Shift+P` |
